data.name: Twisted Rope
data.description: A hangman can spend 1 hour preparing his noose, granting it %1 temporary hit points, giving it a hardness of %1 plus double the weapon's enhancement bonus (or its current hardness, whichever is better), and changing its break DC %3 (or its current break DC, whichever is better). These benefits last for 8 hours, but end immediately if the hangman prepares another noose.|VigilanteLVL|VigilanteLVL/2|23+(VigilanteLVL/2)
